title: The story of Enarian Online - A Vibe Coded ARPG Style Mud - Featuring in Steam Next Fest and full launch on the 25th of June.
author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
selftext:
# The Story

After 18 months development work, Enarian Online is getting ready to launch on the 25th of June right after the upcoming Steam Next Fest which begins on Monday..

I initially started this as a experiment having long been a fan of the Discworld Mud, and having set up and run a circle mud back in the 90s as part of my college course, to see what I could create from scratch with the assistance of AI. 

I started off using ChatGPT but manually handling the files and structure of the game, which proved very successful if some what frustrating since it oftern would make mistakes or get stuck in loops trying to fix bugs, daily backups of the files were essential!

After about a year of this, I discovered Cursor and this made things so much simpler, especially as it got closer to a finished product, its ability to work directly on the files and to manage big changes across multiple files almost flawlessly was amazing. And allowed me to add systems that I previously thought would just be too difficult and complicated to achieve.

What initially was simply a mud, purely text based input and output, really began to resemble my initial concept when I developed the custom arpg style client, building on it to make it more accessible to people who haven't played text based games.

Now you can play the game entirely by typing into the command bar, or almost entirely by mouse, or a mixture of both. 

Visual elements of the client make it much clearer what is going on, including health bars, skill buttons, quest tracker, mini map, floating damage text, and more.

Please check out the game on **Steam**, and don't forget to **wish list** as this will be a massive help going into Next Fest.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4218510/Enarian\_Online/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4218510/Enarian_Online/)

Discord: [https://discord.com/invite/HwftpU34zG](https://discord.com/invite/HwftpU34zG)

# About the Game

Dive into **Enarian Online**, a rich text-based Action RPG mud, that blends the depth and imagination of classic MUDs with the relentless progression and build-driven gameplay of modern ARPGs. Inspired by ARPG and MMORPG genre giants, Enarian Online proves that text is not a limitation, it is a strength. Every line of description, every combat message, and every item drop is crafted to spark your imagination and keep you fully engaged.

In **Enarian Online**, you are torn from your home realm and cast into a strange, broken world. 

You awaken within the **Aetherian Spire**, a vast and damaged nexus that once safeguarded the balance between realms. Around you is a small survivor camp, home to guardians, healers, and warriors who are bound to the spire.

Your task is simple, and dangerous. Use the portal to enter these realms, defeat the evil that has claimed a fragment, and return stronger than before. Each success brings you closer to restoring the Heartstone and, perhaps, finding a way home.

Play as one of 5 classes, but with access to all of the skills and abilities allowing you to build your character into exactly what you want it to be.

A mage that wear plate armour and uses a sword a shield, a Paladin wearing cloth armour and a mix of Mage and Paladin spells. A Rogue in leather armour using a powerful two handed bow. 

Alone or with up to 3 other players in a group, fight your way through procedurally generated maps across 50 levels, 9 Regions and against powerful bosses, to unravel the story of the shattering of the Heartstone.

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: What are you using for your backend server so multiple people can play together online and things be smoothly synced so every action each player takes is seen by the other players? I am trying to learn how this aspect of online games works. Thank you.

replies.author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
replies.body: Its essentially a mud with a custom client. So its a single authoritative server that multiple clients send requests to. Server wide clocks and individual threads provide the timing etc. Nothing happens client side so no cheating beyond possibly macros and bots.

replies.author: Revelation12Studios
replies.body: Interesting. What is the name of the service you use for the server?
